name: io.agentweather/agent-weather
title: Agent Weather
description: Pay per call, solves one question. Free observation desk: propose a task; declined is the default.

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Free. Returns whether the Agent Weather API and its XRPL payment facilitator are reachable, the API version, and the list of paid routes with their prices and accepted assets (from /.well-known/x402). Returns no report data. No inputs.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Free. Day-old index of the Agent Weather AI model directory: model id, name, vendor and categories only (models first seen at least 24 h ago; flagged in `snapshot`). Live prices, context length, vendor status, 24h/7d changes, job cost and events are in the paid get_model_report and get_model_category tools. Not a ranking. Supports filtering by vendor, category or text query and pagination (limit/offset). Use the ids with the paid get_model_report tool.

vendor.description: Filter by vendor slug, e.g. openai

tools.name: paycheck_demo
tools.description: Free. A full Pay Radar example for Agent Weather's own /v1/pulse/facilitator: raw checks first (reachable, latency, tls, x402 shape, asset, payTo fields), then reasons and a summary of signals. Cached up to 10 minutes. No inputs.

tools.name: payradar_demo
tools.description: Free. A full Pay Radar example for Agent Weather's own /v1/pulse/facilitator: raw checks first (reachable, latency, tls, x402 shape, asset, payTo fields), then reasons and a summary of signals. Cached up to 10 minutes. No inputs.

tools.name: get_sample_yesterday
tools.description: Free. Returns a day-old sample of the conditions report (previous calendar day, America/Chicago) so you can inspect the report format before paying. Not live data. No inputs.

tools.name: get_models_sample_yesterday
tools.description: Free. Returns the day-old change summary of the AI model directory (previous calendar day, America/Chicago): listing, price and status changes as declared by public sources. Not live data. No inputs.

tools.name: get_observation_desk
tools.description: Free. Index of the Physical Observation Desk. An agent may propose a physical observation task in plain language. A human operator accepts or declines each one; declined is the default. A proposal is a request for a quote, not a contract, until accepted. If accepted, the visit is quoted separately and the deliverable is an observation record (a reading with time and source), not a rating, advice, or a promised outcome. Intake is free for now. No inputs.

tools.name: submit_observation_desk_request
tools.description: Free for now. Submit a natural-language proposal for a physical observation task. A human operator accepts or declines each one; declined is the default. A proposal is a request for a quote, not a contract, until accepted. If accepted, the visit is quoted separately and the deliverable is an observation record (a reading with time and source), not a rating, advice, or a promised outcome. Requires an ask, a coarse place, and acknowledgement of every exclusion. Returns a request id and a lookup token for later status checks. Not a payment and not an acceptance.

ask.description: Exactly what you are asking the human to do, in natural language.

cannot_do_itself.description: What the agent cannot do itself. Recommended for a complete proposal.

place_label.description: Coarse place label (region, county, city, public site name, or intersection). Do not send a home address or another person's personal address.

place_permission.description: public if the site is publicly accessible; requester_claims_authority if you claim authority for a non-public site.

exclusions_acknowledged.description: Acknowledge every exclusion before submitting: trespass, surveillance_of_people, identifiable_people_without_consent, hazardous_or_illegal, private_property_without_permission, personal_data_of_others, trade_or_repair_work, medical_legal_or_financial_advice.

kinds.description: Optional record-media labels only. Not required.

principal_label.description: Optional label for the requesting agent.

tools.name: get_observation_desk_request
tools.description: Free. Look up the public status of a submitted observation-desk proposal by request id and the lookup token returned at submit time. This is not an operator token and not the private operator dashboard. Does not accept or charge the task. Declined is the default until a human operator accepts.

id.description: Request id returned at submit time.

token.description: Lookup token returned at submit time. Not an operator token.
